You said:
Which iPhone calendar apps offer a Live Activity or Dynamic Island countdown to my next meeting? Distinguish this from a Lock Screen widget or an ordinary reminder notification, and cite current official sources.
ChatGPT said:

As of October 23, 2026, there are iPhone apps that can display a genuine Live Activity countdown to your next calendar event in the Dynamic Island. The important distinction is whether the countdown follows your actual calendar automatically, rather than requiring you to create a separate countdown or tap a reminder.

What qualifies?

Feature

	

Counts as what you're looking for?




Live Activity in Dynamic Island

	

 Yes — a persistent, updating countdown at the top of the screen




Live Activity on Lock Screen

	

 Yes — same underlying feature, displayed while locked




Lock Screen widget

	

 No — a widget showing your next appointment isn't necessarily a Live Activity




Calendar reminder notification

	

 No — an alert before a meeting isn't a continuously updating countdown

Apple explicitly distinguishes Live Activities from ordinary widgets. Live Activities use ActivityKit and can appear in both the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen, whereas standard widgets have a different update mechanism. 
Apple Developer Documentation
+1

Apps with confirmed Live Activity support

These are supported by developer documentation or developer-maintained App Store descriptions, rather than third-party recommendation lists.

1. Proximum

Strong match

Reads iCloud, Google, Exchange and Outlook calendars already configured on your iPhone. Its Pro Live Activity counts down to your next event in the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen, then transitions to the ongoing meeting or following event. It also supports background restoration and automatic transitions.

Caveat: Live Activity is a paid Pro feature, and the developer documents some iOS reliability limitations.

2. What Now – Live Calendar

Strong match

Automatically tracks current events, remaining meeting time, and free time until your next event. Supports the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen, with scheduling ahead of the first meeting.

Caveat: Free for one calendar. Pro adds multiple calendars, configurable Live Activity lead time, and meeting-join shortcuts.

Official App Store listing

3. GroupCal

Manual activation

Its Track Live feature displays a real-time countdown in the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen, plus shortcuts to join video calls or navigate to meeting locations.

Caveat: You must long-press an event reminder and select Track Live. This is not a fully automatic next-meeting countdown.

Official feature announcement

4. Timely

Countdown-focused

Syncs with Apple Calendar and offers real-time Live Activity countdowns on the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen.

Caveat: Its documented smart triggers can prompt you to launch a countdown 5 minutes to 2 hours before an event. I would not assume every upcoming meeting automatically becomes a Live Activity without interaction.

Which would I choose?

Proximum and What Now are the two clearest matches for the specific requirement of automatically showing the next meeting from your existing calendar in the Dynamic Island.

Choose Proximum for a broader calendar experience, multiple calendar sources, and configurable event behavior. Choose What Now for a focused now/next display, particularly if you want to try the feature free with one calendar.

There is one important system limitation: Apple normally limits an individual Live Activity to eight hours in the Dynamic Island. Apps must manage renewals or transitions, and iOS can affect whether activities start or refresh reliably. A continuously updating countdown is therefore possible, but uninterrupted 24/7 visibility is not guaranteed.
